it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Canalipoli:\nFerruccio

id: The Man with the Steel Body!
en: The Man with the Steel Body!

id: \bThis town is somewhat landlocked, but if you can sail it doesn't seem so bad.
en: \bThis town is somewhat landlocked, but if you can sail it doesn't seem so bad.
it: \bQuesta città è un po' isolata, ma se sai navigare non sembra poi così male.

id: \rHave you been to the library? They have some books on the myths of Sinnoh.
en: \rHave you been to the library? They have some books on the myths of Sinnoh.
it: \rSei stato in biblioteca? Hanno dei libri sui miti di Sinnoh.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \bYou're from Kanto? What are you doing way out here?
en: \bYou're from Kanto? What are you doing way out here?
it: \bVieni da Kanto? Che ci fai così lontano?

id: The door is tightly shut. It appears impossible to open.
en: The door is tightly shut. It appears impossible to open.
it: La porta è chiusa saldamente. Sembra impossibile aprirla.

id: \rNobody hangs out in Marts anymore. People seem in a hurry to keep moving.
en: \rNobody hangs out in Marts anymore. People seem in a hurry to keep moving.
it: \rNessuno passa più il tempo nei Market. La gente sembra sempre di fretta.
